scripts.text:
You have too many items to proceed with the quest.
Please lighten your load and try again.
scripts.translation:
您攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續任務。
請減輕負重後再試一次。

scripts.text: Conquering {0}
scripts.translation: 征服{0}

scripts.text: Guild Dungeon Daily Quests
scripts.translation: 公會副本每日任務

scripts.text: About quests
scripts.translation: 關於任務

scripts.text: I don't need it.
scripts.translation: 我不需要。

scripts.text:
{0}
If you have luck on your side, you'll have good results.
scripts.translation:
{0}
如果運氣好，結果就會不錯。

scripts.text: I'll come back later.
scripts.translation: 我稍後再來。

scripts.text: Let's check right now!
scripts.translation: 現在檢視！

scripts.text:
{0}
I'm sorry but you can complete this mission only during the siege hours. I'm afraid I can't do anything here.
scripts.translation:
{0}
很抱歉，您只能在攻城戰期間完成此任務。恐怕我無能為力。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: Give up the quest.
scripts.translation: 放棄任務

scripts.text:
{0}
I'm not sure how long you can use the guild dungeon, but good luck.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我不確定您能使用公會副本多久，但祝您好運。

scripts.text:
{0}
Well, no one's forcing you.
Do whatever you like to do.
I'll cancel the mission then.
scripts.translation:
{0}
好吧，沒人強迫您。
請隨意。
那麼，我將取消該任務。

scripts.text:
{0}
I have confirmed that the waiting time for this mission is over.
I'll delete the records used for confirmation.
Now, give it a try to complete the quest!
scripts.translation:
{0}
我已確認此任務的等待時間已結束。
我將刪除用於確認的記錄。
現在，請嘗試完成任務吧！

scripts.text:
{0}
This is the {1} mission in {2}.

{0}
I'll reward you accordingly upon completing this mission.
scripts.translation:
{0}
完成此任務後，我會給予相應的獎勵。

scripts.text:
{0}
I'll give you experience points in return.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我會給予經驗值作為回報。

scripts.text: Accept it.
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Reject it.
scripts.translation: 拒絕

scripts.text:
{0}
Well, do as you wish.
scripts.translation:
{0}
好吧，隨您便。

scripts.text:
{0}
It's not difficult at all.
I give a reward ^4d4dffdepending on how many fortresses you have conquered.^000000
^4d4dffThe type and quality of the reward depend on the number of conquered fortresses at the very moment I check.^000000
scripts.translation:
{0}
這並不難。
我會根據您攻陷的堡壘數量給予^4d4dff獎勵。^000000
^4d4dff獎勵的種類和品質取決於我檢查時您已攻陷的堡壘數量。^000000

scripts.text:
{0}
If you are a master of a guild that is currently participating in siege battles, you should give it a try.
scripts.translation:
{0}
如果您是正在參加攻城戰的公會的會長，建議您嘗試一下。

scripts.text:
{0}
You're really something else~!
scripts.translation:
{0}
您真是與眾不同呢~！

scripts.text: It is to deal with the powerful creatures that appear in the Corridor of the Abyss.
scripts.translation: 任務是處理出現在深淵迴廊中的強大生物。

scripts.text: It is to eliminate the monsters that appear in the guild dungeon.
scripts.translation: 任務是消滅出現在公會副本中的魔物。

scripts.text: You should hunt 50 or more Caterpillars and Creamy Fear monsters..
scripts.translation: 您需要獵殺50只或以上的狂暴綠棉蟲和狂暴克瑞米。

scripts.text: Hunt down 30 or more of all 3 types of Abyss Kobolds.
scripts.translation: 獵殺30只或以上的所有3種深淵刺錘犬妖。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffYou should kill furious 'Pyuriel' and warrior 'Lora'.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff您需要擊敗狂暴的'Pyuriel'和戰士'Lora'。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 50 or more of Giant Hornets and Ancient Worms, respectively.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff分別獵殺50只或以上的狂暴蜂兵和狂暴蜈蚣。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 40 or more of Killer Mantises and 50 or more of Angra Mantises.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff獵殺40只或以上的殺手螳螂和50只或以上的安格拉螳螂。^000000

scripts.text: They are ^4d4dff'Elvira' and 'Gioia,' which is a strange mechanical creature of heroes' tears.^000000
scripts.translation: 它們是^4d4dff'埃維亞'和'喬伊亞'，一種由英雄之淚構成的奇異機械生物。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 50 or more Zombie Masters and Wraith Deads, respectively.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff分別獵殺50只或以上的腐屍首領和狂暴惡靈。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 50 GLD_DARK_SHADOW, 20 GLD_DARK_FRAME, and 20 GLD_DARK_PRIEST monsters.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff獵殺50只GLD_DARK_SHADOW、20只GLD_DARK_FRAME和20只GLD_DARK_PRIEST。^000000

scripts.text: They are ^4d4dff'Kades' and 'Rudo' who wander around the dead's hill.^000000
scripts.translation: 它們是^4d4dff在死者之丘遊蕩的'Kades'和'魯盜'。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 50 or more Gullinbursti and Leib Olmai, respectively.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff分別獵殺50只或以上的狂暴野豬和狂暴大腳熊。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 45 or more Skeleton General, 20 or more Am Mut and 25 or more Gajomart, respectively.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff分別獵殺45只或以上的邪骸戰士長、20只或以上的狂暴小土人和25只或以上的狂暴鬼火。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffThey are Old Empire's General 'Daehyon' and Guard 'Soheon'.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff它們是舊帝國的將軍'Daehyon'和衛兵'Soheon'。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 50 or more Hell Apocalypse and Zakudam, respectively.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff分別獵殺50只或以上的地獄阿修羅機械戰士和扎庫坦。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 35 or more Heavy Metaling and Cobalt Mineral, respectively.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff分別獵殺35只或以上的礦石波利和鈷礦石魔。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt more than 50 Banshee Masters and 30 Beholder Masters.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff獵殺50只以上的女妖首領和30只以上的大眼怪首領。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 50 Aunoes, and 20 Fanats.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff獵殺50只阿烏奴艾和20只法恩特。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 30 or more Knight, Blacksmith, Assassin, respectively.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff分別獵殺30只或以上的騎士、鐵匠和刺客。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 30 or more Wizard, Priest, Hunter respectively.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff分別獵殺30只或以上的巫師、牧師和獵人。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 30 or more, Crusader, Rogue, Alchemist, respectively.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff分別獵殺30只或以上的十字軍、流氓和鍊金術士。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 30 or more Sage, Monk, Bard, respectively.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff分別獵殺30只或以上的賢者、武僧和詩人。^000000
